env_allowlist.PATH: runner-provided local Python and Git command discovery

network_enforcement: The checker reads and hashes repository-local authority, target, receipt, and handoff files only. It makes no network request and performs no Lake update, build, clone, fetch, checkout, repair, or .lake mutation.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line negative release summary ending verdict=blocked audit_complete=false theorem_complete=false

scope_boundary: Reconciles the current planned authority, frozen root cut, provisional proof and validation observations, receipt conflicts, and release assurance failures. It validates only the blocked decision; it creates no accepted state, obligation closure, M0/E0/E1 credit, AUDIT-Z, THEOREM-Z, release, theorem completion, or master acceptance.
